acceptance_criteria.description: Submit validates fields/types/cycles atomically; idempotent only on normalized original-spec match; views exact keys/detached/sorted; get/list validate without implicit recover.
Claim validates then recovers expired leases in same txn, claims one eligible job by priority/id, bumps attempts/lease; never double-leases across processes; failed deps stay ineligible.
Complete/fail require running+owner+attempt+now<lease with no side-recover/write on reject; clear lease; correct terminal/retry_delay/cap; reject stale attempts.
CLI strict op/field whitelist, sorted-keys+newline exit-0, exit-2 empty-stdout on any error; fresh-process durability; stdlib-only temp-dir tests pass via unittest discover.

assumptions: SQLite file DB with integer now, no wall clock
Queue and python -m durable_queue entry points frozen
discoveries: queue.submit uses INSERT OR REPLACE: clobbers state, no validation/atomicity/cycle/idempotency/detach handling
claim/recover/complete/fail unimplemented; storage.connect has no WAL/BEGIN IMMEDIATE/timeout discipline
__main__ lacks exit-2/unknown-field/sorted-keys/newline handling; tests/test_public.py covers happy path only
goal: Complete durable_queue package and JSON CLI per CONTRACT.md with atomic cross-process semantics and regression tests.
risks: Cross-process double-claim without BEGIN IMMEDIATE + single-txn recover+claim
Invalid batch partially committing including implicit recovery side effects
Recovery ready_at must be expired lease_until vs unchanged on exhaustion; bool-as-int and non-finite JSON acceptance

steps.instructions: Harden storage: WAL, busy timeout, BEGIN IMMEDIATE txn helper. Store normalized spec plus live view. Implement strict submit validation, batch dup/cycle/unknown/self checks, idempotent same-spec else reject, atomic commit/rollback without implicit recover, no input mutation.
steps.title: Storage transactions and atomic submit

steps.instructions: Implement recover(now) and claim(worker,now,lease_seconds) in one IMMEDIATE txn each: validate ints, recover lease_until<=now with ready_at/exhaustion rules, then claim single eligible job ordered by priority/id, set running/attempts/worker/lease.
steps.title: Atomic claim and lease recovery

steps.instructions: Implement complete/fail with strict validation (running, owner, positive attempt match, now<lease, retry_delay int>=0), zero writes on reject, clear lease, succeeded vs pending-with-backoff vs failed-on-exhaustion, attempt cap enforcement.
steps.title: Stale-safe complete and bounded fail

steps.instructions: Harden CLI: strict op/field whitelist, fresh Queue per invocation, sorted-keys single-line exit-0, exit-2 empty-stdout on ValueError/malformed/UTF-8/missing/usage/DB error. Add test_regression.py and test_processes.py for rollback, stale/expired, retries, deps, subprocess exclusivity and reopen durability.
steps.title: Strict CLI and regression tests

verification_strategy.description: V1 contract matrix: run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v plus targeted checks for validation, ordering, leases, retries, idempotency.
V2 separate-process durability/exclusivity: run python3.12 -m unittest tests.test_processes -v covering concurrent claimants and kill/restart reopen.
V3 CLI roundtrips: run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v and manual python3.12 -m durable_queue --db PATH --request FILE success/error exit-code checks.
